title: Face it squarely
text: Shoot from in front, not from the side. A little angle is fine; the reader straightens up to about 40°.

issues: The dial is turned 62° away. Face it more squarely.

title: Fill the frame
text: Get close enough that the dial fills most of the photo. Small dials lose their numbers.

issues: The gauge is small in the frame. Move closer.
The photo is a little soft.

title: Keep glare off the needle
text: Glass faces reflect lights. Step sideways until the bright spot moves off the needle and the numbers.

issues: Glare crosses the needle. Step to the left or tilt the phone.

title: Hold still
text: Brace your arm or wait for the camera to focus. Blur smears the thin ticks the reader measures.

issues: The photo is a little soft.
Can't read the scale numbers. Get closer or reduce glare.
